newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3874/3.3910 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3874/3.3910 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3830 and 3.3900 pounds bid and from 3.3870 to 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market on Sunday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3874 pounds bid and 3.3910 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3885 and 3.3910 pounds on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389847 buy and 3.398146 sell.
